title: Shape
content: Applied describes materials removal as precision shaping of target atoms while protecting adjacent films and structures. Conductor etch removes conducting and semiconductor materials; dielectric etch removes insulating films and generally requires higher energy. Reactive ion etch is used for both, while atomic layer etching supports low-ion-energy precision. Selective removal uses radical-based chemistry for complex vertical structures such as FinFET, 3D NAND and gate-all-around devices. CMP uses chemistry and abrasives to remove targeted metal and dielectric films and create a planar foundation.

title: Product Library
content: Applied Materials Product Library exposes semiconductor technology filters including CMP, CVD, ALD, Epitaxy, Etch, PVD, ECD, metrology and inspection. It is a discovery/index page useful for finding product-family pages and should be treated as a navigation seed rather than a technical specification document.

title: Endura Trillium ALD
content: Endura Trillium ALD deposits atomically thin films with uniform thickness and composition along high-aspect-ratio features. The platform supports high-k metal-gate work-function metals, dipole layers, liner films and capping films, and can integrate clean and treatment technologies.

title: Olympia ALD
content: Olympia is a stand-alone ALD system for dielectric films. Wafers rotate through isolated chemistry zones; each exposure creates an additional monolayer. The page emphasizes low-temperature film quality, precursor separation, low defects and sequencing flexibility for planar and 3D devices.

title: Producer Precision Selective Nitride PECVD
content: Producer Precision Selective Nitride is a selective bottom-up nitride deposition technology for advanced GAA transistor architectures. It deposits nitride at the trench bottom to protect STI height, reduce parasitic capacitance and support gap-fill requirements.

title: Building on an Unmatched Foundation of CVD Innovation
content: The article describes Applied's CVD history and applications in dielectric films, DRAM capacitor gap fill and advanced patterning. It discusses Producer XP Pioneer patterning film and its co-optimization with Draco hard mask and Sym3 Y HT etch for deep, uniform capacitor holes.

title: Etch
content: Lam explains etch as selective removal of deposited films. RIE activates the wafer surface with ions; ALE removes a few atomic layers at a time. Conductor etch shapes electrically active components, dielectric etch forms insulating structures, and etch creates tall high-aspect-ratio structures such as TSVs.

title: Akara
content: Akara is described as a high-volume-production conductor etch system. The page emphasizes millisecond response to process changes, angstrom-level critical-dimension uniformity and wafer-to-wafer repeatability.

title: Selective Etch Product Family
content: Lam's selective etch portfolio targets isotropic material removal with angstrom-scale precision and high selectivity for 3D logic and memory. Applications include dummy poly removal, SiGe removal for GAA, oxide recess, silicon trimming, source/drain deposition preclean, low-k removal and surface decontamination.

title: Coronus Product Family
content: Coronus targets the wafer bevel. Bevel etch removes masks, residues and films that can become particle sources; bevel deposition protects the edge during long etch steps and wafer bonding. The product family is positioned for yield improvement and multi-material film-stack removal.

title: Vantex Product Family
content: Vantex is a cryogenic etching product family designed for the Sense.i platform. Lam positions it for high-aspect-ratio etching and advanced memory applications.

title: Our Processes
content: Lam describes deposition as forming dielectric and metal layers. ECD creates copper wiring for interconnect, TSV and wafer-level packaging; CVD and ALD form tungsten connectors and barrier films; PECVD, HDP-CVD and ALD form insulating layers.

product_name: ALTUS Halo; Concept Two ALTUS; ALTUS Max
title: ALTUS Product Family
content: ALTUS product offerings include ALD and CVD for plug, contact and via fill, 3D NAND wordlines and WN barriers. The page describes pulsed nucleation layer ALD, multi-station sequential deposition, integrated advanced chemical etch clean and options for thermal/plasma pretreatment.

sub_process: Wet Clean; Wet Etch; Photoresist Strip
product_name: Reliant Clean; Da Vinci; SP Series
title: Reliant Clean Products
content: Lam's Reliant spin wet clean products address FEOL, BEOL and backside/bevel cleaning. The page lists process flexibility, 150 mm to 300 mm ultra-thin substrate handling, wafer and lot uniformity, and applications including wet clean, wet etch, wet photoresist strip and silicon wafer thinning.

title: SP Series Product Family
content: SP Series provides production-proven wet clean and wet etch solutions for advanced wafer-level packaging. The page emphasizes selective removal of specific materials while leaving fragile structures undisturbed.
